name: Ardenmoor, the North
description: Hills, mist and a very old graveyard. The land goes quiet here, and the quiet is not restful.

an_0_0.name: The Standing Stones
an_0_0.description: A circle of tall grey stones, leaning in toward one another as though to share a secret. The hills rise beyond them, and the mist lies on the hills.

an_0_1.name: The Hollow Graves
an_0_1.description: A wide field of low stones that nobody keeps. A great mausoleum of black marble stands at its heart, and the door of it is open.

an_0_2.name: The Eastern Rise
an_0_2.description: A bare, round rise of earth. A lantern hangs from a stake by a cave mouth, and the door of the cave is open.

an_1_0.name: The Withered Wood
an_1_0.description: A wood of dead trees, standing grey and dry, with a trader's cave dug into a bank among the roots.

an_1_1.name: The Black Pool
an_1_1.description: A round pool of water so black that it takes the sky. A dead tree leans over it. The ground around it is very still.

an_1_2.name: The Hill Road
an_1_2.description: A road along a hill, and a thick green bush as tall as a man beside it. It looks as though it has stood there longer than the hill.

fire.message: The bush goes up in a rush of orange, and where it stood there is a low dark doorway.

an_2_0.name: The Northern Road, West
an_2_0.description: A cart road running north between hedges, rutted and empty.

an_2_1.name: The Northern Road
an_2_1.description: A cart road running north between hedges, rutted and empty.

an_2_2.name: The Northern Road, East
an_2_2.description: A cart road running north between hedges, rutted and empty.

candle_shop.name: A Candle-Lit Cave
candle_shop.description: A cave lit by more candles than it needs, set in niches all over the walls.

shield_shop.name: A Shield-Hung Cave
shield_shop.description: A cave whose walls are hung with shields of every size.

fairy_pool.name: The Fairy Pool
fairy_pool.description: A round pool of water as clear as glass, and over it a small light hovers, humming a tune of its own.

heart_cave.name: A Cave Under the Bush
heart_cave.description: A little cave behind where the bush stood, dry and very quiet. Something red shines at the back of it.
